name: Mordheim Skills

source.note: Verified directly against the PDF text (pages 84-85), not a secondary extract.

skillCategories.name: Shooting
skillCategories.description: Skills associated with missile weapons and shooting.

skillCategories.name: Speed
skillCategories.description: Skills based on movement and agility.

skillCategories.name: Special
skillCategories.description: A warband's own unique skill list, used instead of or alongside the standard five - currently the Sisters of Sigmar and Skaven each have one.

skills.name: Strike to Injure
skills.description: Add +1 to all injury rolls caused by the model in hand-to-hand combat.

skills.name: Combat Master
skills.description: If fighting against two or more enemies at once, gains an extra Attack in each hand-to-hand combat phase and is immune to 'All Alone' tests.

skills.name: Weapons Training
skills.description: May use any hand-to-hand combat weapon encountered, not just those in his equipment options.

skills.name: Web of Steel
skills.description: Gains +1 to all his rolls on Critical Hit tables in hand-to-hand combat.

skills.name: Expert Swordsman
skills.description: May re-roll all missed attacks when using a sword in the hand-to-hand phase of the turn he charges. Only applies to normal swords, not double-handed swords or other weapons.

skills.name: Step Aside
skills.description: Each time he suffers a wound in close combat, may make an additional 5+ saving throw. This save is never modified and is taken after all other armour saves.

skills.name: Quick Shot
skills.description: May shoot twice per turn with a bow or crossbow (but not a crossbow pistol).

skills.name: Pistolier
skills.description: If equipped with a brace of pistols of any type (including crossbow pistols), may fire twice in the Shooting phase (normal reloading rules still apply). With a single pistol, may fire it the same turn it was reloaded.

skills.name: Eagle Eyes
skills.description: Adds +6" to the range of any missile weapon he is using.

skills.name: Weapons Expert
skills.description: May use any missile weapon encountered, not just those available from his warband's list.

skills.name: Nimble
skills.description: May move and fire weapons that are normally only usable if the firer hasn't moved. Cannot be combined with Quick Shot.

skills.name: Trick Shooter
skills.description: Ignores all modifiers for cover when using missile weapons.

skills.name: Hunter
skills.description: May fire every turn with a handgun or Hochland long rifle, ignoring their usual reload restriction.

skills.name: Knife-Fighter
skills.description: May throw up to three throwing knives/stars per shooting phase, dividing shots between any targets in range as he wishes. Cannot be combined with Quick Shot.

skills.name: Unstoppable Charge
skills.description: Adds +1 to his Weapon Skill when charging.

skills.name: Battle Tongue
skills.description: Leaders only. Increases the range of his Leader ability by 6". Undead leaders may not use this skill.

skills.name: Sorcery
skills.description: Spellcasters only. Gains +1 to his rolls to successfully cast spells. Sisters of Sigmar and Warrior-Priests may not use this skill.

skills.name: Streetwise
skills.description: Adds +2 to the roll that determines his chances of finding rare items when trading.

skills.name: Haggle
skills.description: May deduct 2D6 gold crowns from the price of any single item (minimum cost 1gc), once per post-battle sequence.

skills.name: Arcane Lore
skills.description: Witch Hunters, Sisters of Sigmar and Warrior-Priests may not have this skill. Lets a warrior learn Lesser Magic if he owns a Tome of Magic.

skills.name: Wyrdstone Hunter
skills.description: When searching the ruins in the exploration phase, may re-roll one dice on the Exploration chart - the second result stands.

skills.name: Warrior Wizard
skills.description: Spellcasters only. Allows the wizard to wear armour and still cast spells.

skills.name: Mighty Blow
skills.description: Gains a +1 Strength bonus in close combat (excluding pistols), applying to all close combat weapons he uses.

skills.name: Pit Fighter
skills.description: Adds +1 to his Weapon Skill and +1 Attack when fighting inside buildings or ruins.

skills.name: Resilient
skills.description: Deducts -1 Strength from all hits against him in close combat. Does not affect armour save modifiers.

skills.name: Fearsome
skills.description: Causes fear in opposing models.

skills.name: Strongman
skills.description: May use a double-handed weapon without the usual penalty of always striking last.

skills.name: Leap
skills.description: May leap D6" in the movement phase in addition to normal movement (can move and leap, run and leap, or charge and leap, once per turn). May jump over man-sized models and obstacles up to 1" high without penalty; may also leap over gaps, committing to the leap before rolling.

skills.name: Sprint
skills.description: Triples his Movement rate when running or charging, instead of doubling it.

skills.name: Acrobat
skills.description: May fall or jump up to 12" without damage if he passes a single Initiative test, and may re-roll failed Diving Charge rolls (up to a maximum diving charge height of 6").

skills.name: Lightning Reflexes
skills.description: Strikes first against models that charge him that turn, resolved by comparing Initiative against the charger(s) (who also strike first for charging).

skills.name: Jump Up
skills.description: Springs back to his feet immediately if knocked down, and ignores Knocked Down results when rolling for injuries - unless the knock down came from a successful helmet save or the No Pain special rule.

skills.name: Dodge
skills.description: May avoid a missile hit entirely on a D6 roll of 5+, rolled as soon as the hit is scored - before rolling to wound and before any other skill or equipment effects.

skills.name: Scale Sheer Surfaces
skills.description: May climb up or down a height equal to twice his normal Movement, without needing an Initiative test.

skills.name: Sign of Sigmar
skills.description: Possessed or Undead opponents lose their first attack against the Sister in the first round of hand-to-hand combat (down to a minimum of 1).

skills.name: Protection of Sigmar
skills.description: Any spell which would affect her is nullified on a D6 roll of 4+. If the spell is nullified it does not affect any other models either.

skills.name: Utter Determination
skills.description: Only the Matriarch may take this skill - allows her to re-roll any failed Rout tests.

skills.name: Righteous Fury
skills.description: Hates all Skaven, Undead or Possessed warbands and every model in them.

skills.name: Absolute Faith
skills.description: May re-roll any failed Fear tests, and does not have to test if fighting alone against several opponents.

skills.name: Black Hunger
skills.description: May declare at the start of his turn that he is drawing on the Black Hunger, gaining +1 Attack and +D3" Movement for the duration of the turn, but suffering D3 Strength 3 hits with no armour save possible at the end of the turn.

skills.name: Tail Fighting
skills.description: May wield a shield, knife or sword with its tail - gains an extra attack with the appropriate weapon, or a +1 bonus to its armour save.

skills.name: Wall Runner
skills.description: Does not need to take an Initiative test when climbing walls or other sheer surfaces.

skills.name: Infiltration
skills.description: Is always placed on the battlefield after the opposing warband, and may be placed anywhere out of sight of the enemy and more than 12" from any enemy model.

skills.name: Art of Silent Death
skills.description: Fights bare-handed with no penalty and counts as having two weapons (+1 Attack). Causes a critical hit on a To Wound roll of 5-6 instead of just 6. May be combined with Eshin Fighting Claws for +2 Attacks instead of +1.

skills.name: Quiet as a Mouse
skills.description: Adept at staying quiet whilst hiding - enemy warriors must use half their Initiative value in inches (rounded down) when trying to detect this hidden Halfling.

skills.name: Crude Belch
skills.description: During the first round of hand-to-hand combat, may release a withering belch upon all enemies in base contact. Each affected enemy must pass a Leadership test or miss its first attack that round (regardless of how many Attacks it has).

skills.name: Wizened Halfling
skills.description: Leaders only - all Halflings may re-roll any failed Leadership test while within 6" of this leader, and may use his Leadership for both the original and the re-rolled test.

skills.name: Stealthy
skills.description: Halfling Thieves only - may hide even after running, and may run within 8" of enemy models if it starts and ends its move hidden.

skills.name: Skilled Huntsman
skills.description: May try to fire a ranged weapon and remain hidden. When shooting from hiding, roll a D6 - on a 3+ the shot stays inconspicuous and the Halfling remains hidden that turn. May not be combined with blackpowder weapons - they're too noisy.

skills.name: Layers of Fat
skills.description: Always has a basic armour save of 6+, regardless of the attacker's Strength, on top of any armour already worn.

skills.name: Shifty
skills.description: Gains a bonus Attack that strikes first when charged.

warbandAccessNotes: Exact skill-category checkmarks for Witch Hunters, Sisters of Sigmar, Undead, Skaven and the Middenheim/Marienburg Mercenary variants could not be read from the source PDF's tables (the checkmark glyphs did not survive text extraction). Reikland's own table did extract cleanly and is the verified basis for its access above; every other warband's access here is a best-effort judgement call following the same shape (leader gets the most categories, elite fighters get a combat-leaning subset, dedicated spellcasters lean Academic) - verify against the printed skill tables before relying on this for a competitive game. Halflings' access was read directly from their own source page's skill table, which was legible.
